summary: A military deployment in the District is facing judicial scrutiny over presidential authority, while separate investigations into a Kennedy Center donation and concerns about National Guard deployment at schools are unfolding. Advocates continue to note that D.C.'s population exceeds that of some states. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
